name: tract_developer_pick_building_draws
description: Test 14 inside a full Grow, by hand from 4.16 / 4.22 with the Python cRZRandom model. Residential developer, demand 1 (desired 1, desiredMax 1), style map {0x2000: 0.3, 0x2001: 0.7}, no anchor, one empty 1 x 1 lot, three compatible configurations C1 < C2 < C3 (tokens 101, 102, 103), all with primary family 600 whose members are inserted in the order 0x100, 0x101, 0x102, 0x2C1, 0x3, all of capacity 1 (window lo 1, hi max(1, 2) = 2). The file-local generator is forced to lcg = mul = 12345 after R1. Existing-lot listing keeps only the first compatible configuration (one candidate). PickBuilding: draw A RandomUint32Uniform(100) = 4 (lcg 0xD3DC167E) -> 4 < 30 -> group 0x2000; S_cfg = {C1, C2, C3}; draw B RandomUint32Uniform(3) = 2 (lcg 0xA70427DF) -> C3; the 193-bucket hash order of the family is 0x3, 0x100, 0x101, 0x102, 0x2C1; draw C RandomUint32Uniform(5) = 2 (lcg 0xD6651C2C) -> building 0x101. Build claims 1, demolishes the lot, starts construction (lot, C3, 0x101); built 1 >= desired ends the call. The mul state is untouched (12345).
